name: Visa-free short stay (Schengen)
summary: Citizens of countries not on the EU visa-required list can visit Sweden without a visa for up to 90 days in any 180-day period. Check the official government.se list to see if your passport needs a visa.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months after you plan to leave the Schengen area
Round-trip ticket with return within 90 days
Host invitation or hotel booking
Money for your stay, SEK 700 per day (can be lower in some cases)
Medical travel insurance of at least EUR 30,000 is recommended
Border police cannot give advance decisions on entry

sources.label: Migrationsverket: If you do not need a visa
Government.se: list of countries requiring a visa
Sweden Abroad: the Schengen area

name: Schengen visa (short stay, up to 90 days)
summary: If your passport is on the EU visa-required list, you need a Schengen visa for visits up to 90 days in any 180-day period. You apply at a Swedish embassy or through VFS Global.

other: Passport valid 3 months after you leave the Schengen area, issued in the past 10 years, 2 blank pages
Medical travel insurance of at least EUR 30,000 valid in all Schengen countries
Funds of SEK 700 per day, plus money for the return trip
Round-trip ticket and proof you will leave on time
Purpose document such as a host invitation, company invitation or admission letter
Airside transit visa rules follow the common EU visa policy. This was not detailed on the pages read.

steps: Check the government.se list to see if your passport needs a visa
Fill in the Schengen visa application form
Apply through VFS Global or a Swedish embassy or consulate (up to 6 months before the trip)
processing: Normally about 15 days from when the embassy receives the application, but it varies by country.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Visiting Sweden for up to 90 days (entry visa)
Government.se: list of countries requiring a visa

name: Visitor's residence permit (stays over 90 days)
summary: A longer visit permit for non-EU citizens who want to stay more than 90 days as a visitor. Length depends on why you visit, for example up to six months for tourists or up to one year for pensioner parents visiting a child.

other: Passport valid at least 3 months after the visit ends
You must plan to leave Sweden afterward
Funds of SEK 700 per day of stay
Medical travel insurance for the whole stay, ideally at least EUR 30,000
Different rules apply to EU/EEA and Swiss citizens

stay.note: Tourists up to 6 months. Relatives up to 6 months (9 with special grounds). Pensioner parents up to 1 year. Medical treatment and volunteers up to 1 year.

processing: About 75% of recent decisions took 3 months if applied from outside Sweden, or 4 months from inside Sweden.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Visiting Sweden for more than 90 days

name: Work permit for employees
summary: General work permit for a job offer from a Swedish employer. Since 1 June 2026 the salary must be at least 90 percent of the median salary, up from 80 percent.

income.note: 90% of the SEK 38,300 median (as of 16 June 2026). Some occupations on a government list need only 75% of the median.

other: Terms at least as good as Swedish collective agreements or what is customary in the occupation
New 2026 rules: employer-related rejections are possible, and employees staying up to one year need comprehensive health insurance
Employer must notify the Agency if the job has not started within 4 months of approval
75% threshold also applies to students and researchers moving to a work permit, temporary protection holders, certain health professionals and certain start-up employees
Extensions of permits granted before 1 June 2026 filed by 1 December 2026 use the old 80% rule (SEK 30,640). From 2 December 2026 the 90% rule applies to all extensions.

stay.note: Max 2 years at a time and never longer than the contract or passport.

name: EU Blue Card
summary: Permit for highly qualified employees with a degree or long experience. Salary must be at least 1.25 times the average Swedish gross salary. Since 2026 a first card can run up to four years.

income.note: As of 15 July 2026. Equals 1.25 times the average gross salary.

eligibility.education: Higher education of at least 180 credits, or at least 5 years of relevant professional experience
other: Highly qualified job lasting at least 6 months, with a contract signed by you and the employer

stay.note: First card valid at least 9 months and at most 4 years.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: EU Blue Cards

name: ICT permit (intra-corporate transfer)
summary: For managers, specialists and trainees moved to Sweden by an employer outside the EU/EEA. Managers and specialists can stay up to three years, trainees up to one.

other: Employed by the company for at least 3 months without a break before the transfer
First ICT permit must be applied for from outside Sweden
Work in Sweden for more than 90 days
Salary at least the collective agreement minimum or customary level. Since June 2026 new minimum levels apply, but the amounts were not stated on the page.
Trainees need a university degree and a traineeship agreement

stay.note: Managers and specialists up to 3 years. Trainees up to 1 year.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: ICT permits

name: Seasonal work permit
summary: For seasonal jobs such as agriculture. Since 2026 you can stay up to nine months in any twelve-month period, up from six.

other: First application must be made from outside the EU
Salary at least the collective agreement minimum or customary level for full-time work, also for part-time jobs
Proper housing rented or owned in your name. You cannot live in someone else's home, including a relative's.
Comprehensive health insurance for the whole stay
You must plan to leave Sweden when the permit ends

stay.note: Up to 9 months within any 12-month period.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Seasonal workers
Migrationsverket: New rules for work permits (employers)

name: Residence permit for self-employed people
summary: For running your own business in Sweden. You need your own money in a bank account and a credible business plan.

savings.note: Plus SEK 100,000 for a spouse and SEK 50,000 per child. Must be your own money, loans are not normally accepted.

other: Enough money to run the business, with a credible budget
The Agency does a financial assessment of your business plan
Balance sheets and profit and loss statements may be required

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Self-employed people

name: Permit to look for work or start a business (highly qualified)
summary: Up to nine months in Sweden to look for a job or explore starting a business, if you have a master's level degree or higher.

eligibility.education: Second-cycle degree: 60 or 120 credit master's, professional degree of 60 to 330 credits, or a postgraduate degree

savings.note: For each month you apply for. Also enough for the return trip.

other: Comprehensive health insurance for the whole stay

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Look for work or start a business

name: Permit to look for work after studying in Sweden
summary: For people who finished higher education studies in Sweden and want to look for work or explore starting a business.

other: Completed higher education studies in Sweden, or completed mobility studies with a Swedish stay
Duration and fee were not shown on the page. Check Migrationsverket before applying.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Look for work after completing your studies in Sweden

name: Residence permit for higher education studies
summary: For full-time on-site university studies in Sweden. New in 2026: bachelor's and master's students can work at most 15 hours a week on permits granted from 11 June 2026.

savings.note: For applications in 2026. Add SEK 4,440 for a spouse and SEK 2,664 per child. Funds must cover the whole permit period.

other: Final admission to full-time on-site studies (30 credits per semester)
Distance learning does not qualify
Tuition fee paid before applying
Comprehensive health insurance if studies last less than one year
Stricter study result rules and an address notification duty were announced in May 2026

stay.note: Permits run 1 or 2 years, not longer than the studies or passport.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Higher education
Migrationsverket: Study permits overview

name: Residence permit to live with a partner
summary: For spouses, registered partners and cohabiting partners of someone living in Sweden. New family-ties rules from 1 October 2026 tighten sponsor requirements and raise the maintenance requirement.

other: Both partners over 21, with exceptions on special grounds such as shared children
The partner in Sweden must be a Swedish or Nordic citizen, a permanent resident, or hold a temporary permit of at least a year with good prospects of permanent residence
Maintenance and housing requirement applies to the partner in Sweden. The new 2026 amount was not shown on the page.
No maintenance requirement if the partner is a Swedish citizen and the relationship is well established
Stricter good conduct rules from 13 July 2026
Other family routes exist (children, other relatives). This record covers partners only.

processing: A decision within 90 days is possible if you lived together abroad for 12 months and meet the relationship criteria.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Live with a partner
Migrationsverket: Live with someone

name: Permanent residence permit
summary: Work permit holders can apply after four years with a permit, having worked in Sweden four of the past seven years. You must support yourself and live an orderly life.

income.note: Left after housing costs, for other living costs (2026 figure). Only taxed, legal income counts. No fixed salary amount.

other: Four years with a work permit, worked in Sweden four of the past seven years
Most other applicants need 3 years with a permit
Orderly life, minor offences can be an obstacle
Adult family members must support themselves and have held a permit for at least 3 years
Apply together with your extension application

stay.note: Valid as long as you live in Sweden.

name: Swedish citizenship by naturalization
summary: New rules from 6 June 2026: eight years of residence instead of five, an income requirement, and a language and society knowledge requirement for ages 16 to 66. No transition period, so pending cases are judged under the new rules.

income.note: Roughly three income base amounts a year, gross, from long-term employment or self-employment. Partner income cannot be combined. Some groups are exempt.

eligibility.language: Swedish and Swedish society knowledge, shown by school certificates, SFI course D, Komvux, folk high school, Tisus, or a citizenship test
other: 8 years of habitual residence in Sweden (10 if you cannot prove your identity)
Stateless people 5 years, recognized refugees 7 years
Orderly and respectable life, now including conduct abroad, with waiting periods after crimes and unpaid debts
Society test available from August 2026. Language test expected no earlier than autumn 2027.
Children are not subject to the income requirement

citizenship.note: Sweden allows dual citizenship, but your other country must also allow it.

name: Swedish citizenship for partners of Swedish citizens
summary: Married or cohabiting with a Swedish citizen cuts the residence requirement to seven years, if you have lived together for at least five years. Income, knowledge and orderly life rules still apply.

other: 7 years of residence in Sweden
Together with the Swedish partner for at least 5 years
Same income, language and orderly life requirements as general naturalization

citizenship.note: Sweden allows dual citizenship, but your other country must also allow it.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: How do you become a Swedish citizen?

name: Swedish citizenship for Nordic citizens
summary: Citizens of other Nordic countries need only two years of residence and can use a notification route.

other: 2 years of residence in Sweden
Conditions of the notification route were not detailed on the page

sources.label: Migrationsverket: How do you become a Swedish citizen?

name: Swedish citizenship by birth or descent
summary: Some children become Swedish citizens at birth, and others can be applied for or notified. Conditions were not on the pages read, so check Migrationsverket. You can also ask for a declaration of citizenship if unsure of your status.

other: Rules for birth, descent and adoption were not confirmed. See Migrationsverket's children's citizenship page.

sources.label: Migrationsverket: Swedish citizenship

name: EU/EEA free movement right of residence
summary: EU/EEA citizens can stay three months with a valid passport or ID card. Longer stays need work, a business, study or enough funds. Permanent right of residence comes after five years.

other: Over 3 months: you must be working, running a business, studying or have enough funds to support yourself
Living in Sweden a year or more: register in the Population Register with the Tax Agency
Non-EU/EEA family members staying over 3 months need a residence card
Nordic citizen rules were not detailed on the page

stay.note: Up to 3 months without conditions. Longer with right of residence.
